iter_04_original_finding.metric: mean cross-layer Pearson of H123 motif feature per domain

synthetic_positive_control.construction: 12 'layers' on 200-gene 4-community synthetic, with noise SD ranging 0.5 → 6.0

verdict: iter_04's cross-layer single-axis finding GENERALISES across feature types within MaxToki: H123 motif 0.645, triangle-defect 0.275, Euclidean distance 0.561. All three feature types are above 0.6 on average — the residual-stream's gene-pair structure barely changes across layers regardless of which feature we look at. This is a property of MaxToki's representational geometry, not specific to H123's signed-motif construction. Synthetic positive control (planted 4-community structure with degrading noise across layers): H123 -0.001, tri 0.000, eucl 0.001. The cross-layer-Pearson metric IS sensitive to single-axis structure (synthetic confirms). Caveat: full replication in a second model (scGPT or Geneformer) would still strengthen this; the current evidence is multi-feature within-MaxToki.
